A ratchet: `pnpm budget` fails when a bucket grows past its number. Raise the number in the same change that adds the weight, so the diff shows what the payload cost. `shell` is what every route pays (the entry plus its vendor chunk); `match` is the Phaser route, which the service worker precaches but a cold load never fetches. 2026-11-08: match 386 -> 388 KiB gzip, css 3 -> 4, total 543 -> 546 (shot animation, terrain/sky). 2026-11-09 (angle ring): match 388 -> 390, total 546 -> 548 — dead `ItemSlots` and the event-feed strings came out first. 2026-11-09 (weather tray): shell 153 -> 154 and css 4 -> 5 — four weather-kind strings and the tray's layout, after moving the per-kind ink into the component so the stylesheet did not carry four decorative rules. 2026-11-11 (US-MATCH-010): match 390 -> 391 — the angle bug fix (`pullBaseAngle`, the latched `pressAngle` field and
`clearOrigin`), about 0.1 KiB. Nothing came out first: the bucket was recorded at exactly 390 and the fix is a correctness
change with no dead weight to trade, so the ratchet moves by the one KiB it needs. 2026-11-10 (US-MATCH-009): total 548 -> 550 — the loadout mapping in the lobby and the practice
starter kit, so the item tray a player picked is no longer empty in every match. 2026-11-13 (US-BAL-001/US-BAL-002): match 391 -> 392 and total 550 -> 551 — the measure view (open, snapped back on a timer, refused shots), the probe readout and the camera-window publishing, about 0.1 KiB each. Nothing came out first: `windowOnBoth` and its margins were deleted in the same change, which is why the growth is a rounding step rather than a KiB. 2026-11-14 (US-BAL-006): match 392 -> 394 and total 551 -> 553 (measured 393.3 and 552.2, rounded up to the next whole KiB as above) — the seat's `Senses` (a window, a remembered reading per opponent, the ground clipped to the window), the three difficulty budgets and `readWind`, and a solver that refines a coarse grid until the landing, not the angle, is close; about 1.15 KiB gzip. What came out first: the whole noise config (`BotConfig`, `angleNoiseDeg`, `powerNoise`), `botTurnPlan`, the 2°/0.25-only grid it searched, the duplicate window-push in `sensesFor` and the second wind lookup, which is roughly 0.2 KiB of the above already netted out. Deleting more would have to take the clipped terrain or the solver itself with it, and AC1 cannot be tested without the first. 2026-11-14 (US-BAL-007): shell 154 -> 155 and total 553 -> 556 (measured 154.7 and 555.6, rounded up), plus two new buckets — `practice` at 2 KiB (measured 1.9) and the shared `ballistics` chunk at 2 KiB (measured 1.2) that Rollup now splits out because both the match and the practice routes import it. What the weight is: the solver's closed form (`barForDistance`/`distanceForBar`/`timeForShot`), the practice screen, its stylesheet rules, and the twenty-five `practice.*` copy keys — which are in the initial chunk by design (`NFR-18`: the language tables are one download), which is why `shell` moved and not only the lazy route. Nothing came out first: the page is a form and an answer box, and the solver is the story. `css` 4 -> 5 was already spent; measured 4.5.
